          {

          },

          },

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": " Vec&lt;GitCommitVertex&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 936
          },
          {
            "text": "        vertices.iter().map(|vertex| {",
            "lineNumber": 937
          },
          {
            "text": "            let mut transformed = vertex.clone();",
            "lineNumber": 938
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 939
          },
          {
            "text": "            // Apply time filtering",
            "lineNumber": 940
          },
          {
            "text": "            if vertex.time &lt; params.time_filter.0 || vertex.time &gt; params.time_filter.1 {",
            "lineNumber": 941
          },
          {
            "text": "                transformed.color[3] = 0.0;",
            "lineNumber": 942
          },
          {
            "text": "                return transformed;",
            "lineNumber": 943
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 944
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 945
          },
          {
            "text": "            // Apply branch filtering",
            "lineNumber": 946
          },
          {
            "text": "            let branch_visible = params.branch_filter.is_empty() ||",
            "lineNumber": 947
          },
          {
            "text": "                params.branch_filter.contains(&amp;vertex.branch_id);",
            "lineNumber": 948
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 949
          },
          {
            "text": "            if !branch_visible {",
            "lineNumber": 950
          },
          {
            "text": "                transformed.color[3] = 0.0;",
            "lineNumber": 951
          },
          {
            "text": "                return transformed;",
            "lineNumber": 952
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 953
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 954
          },
          {
            "text": "            // Apply transformation matrix",
            "lineNumber": 955
          },
          {
            "text": "            let pos = [",
            "lineNumber": 956
          },
          {
            "text": "                vertex.position[0],",
            "lineNumber": 957
          },
          {
            "text": "                vertex.position[1],",
            "lineNumber": 958
          },
          {
            "text": "                vertex.position[2],",
            "lineNumber": 959
          },
          {
            "text": "                1.0,",
            "lineNumber": 960
          },
          {
            "text": "            ];",
            "lineNumber": 961
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 962
          },
          {
            "text": "            let transformed_pos = [",
            "lineNumber": 963
          },
          {
            "text": "                transform.matrix[0][0] * pos[0] + transform.matrix[0][1] * pos[1] + transform.matrix[0][2] * pos[2] + transform.matrix[0][3] * pos[3],",
            "lineNumber": 964
          },
          {
            "text": "                transform.matrix[1][0] * pos[0] + transform.matrix[1][1] * pos[1] + transform.matrix[1][2] * pos[2] + transform.matrix[1][3] * pos[3],",
            "lineNumber": 965
          },
          {
            "text": "                transform.matrix[2][0] * pos[0] + transform.matrix[2][1] * pos[1] + transform.matrix[2][2] * pos[2] + transform.matrix[2][3] * pos[3],",
            "lineNumber": 966
          },
          {
            "text": "                transform.matrix[3][0] * pos[0] + transform.matrix[3][1] * pos[1] + transform.matrix[3][2] * pos[2] + transform.matrix[3][3] * pos[3],",
            "lineNumber": 967
          },
          {
            "text": "            ];",
            "lineNumber": 968
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 969
          },
          {
            "text": "            if transformed_pos[3] != 0.0 {",
            "lineNumber": 970
          },
          {
            "text": "                transformed.position[0] = transformed_pos[0] / transformed_pos[3];",

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 975
          },
          {
            "text": "            transformed",
            "lineNumber": 976
          },
          {
            "text": "        }).collect()",
            "lineNumber": 977
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 978
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 979
          },
          {

          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
